{{Top|leg}}
A '''crystal garden''' was a deposit of [[Laboian mineral crystal|mineral crystals]] that had been carefully tended by a member of the [[Laboi]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Laboi II]]. Members of the [[Snake/Legends|serpentine]] species used tools known as [[stir-stick]]s or natural [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] powers to arrange the naturally occurring deposits of molten [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] into structured gardens when they cooled during the planet's long night.<ref name="GG4b ">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>
